HOSTING_VERB_HOSTS.description: The hosts a verb's implementedBy names (docs/contract-dir.md): the programs a controller sends mod-host's protocol to. A verb states what each one owes it; a host the verb leaves out owes it nothing.
HOSTING_VERB_HOSTS.x-why: A host's verbs were typed twice, in plugin-hostd's protocol.h and in omx-clap-core's command table; a verbs item declares them once, and the hosts it names are a closed list, so a misspelt host is refused rather than read as a host that owes nothing.
